property_summary: Only the original deployer (owner) can successfully call withdrawAll, so calls from the deploying address should not succeed unless this contract is the same as C's owner (i.e., the caller is the owner).
change_summary: Changed require in onlyOwner to require(msg.sender != owner) which flips the guard, allowing only non-owners to pass and thereby preventing the original owner from calling withdrawAll while allowing others to do so.
